developer.title: Developer options
developer.clearExplanation: Removes everything this app stored on the device, including your sign-in. You will need to sign in again.

user.title: Profile
user.summaryPlaceholder: Share a bit about yourself – who you are, your hobbies, what you like to collect, or anything that shows your personality. Add a fun phrase, use emojis, decorate it as much as you want, and if you have collection-related social media accounts, feel free to include links

reports.title: Reports
reports.introMine: Reports are checked against the marketplace rules only. Coffer doesn't decide who was right in a deal.
reports.introAboutMe: When something you posted is removed for breaking a rule, you see here what and why. Who reported it is never shown.

index.reportsSubtitle: Your reports and moderation of your content
index.logoutText: You can sign in again any time with the same account.

profile.noSummaryOwn: You don't have a summary on your profile yet — add a short introduction so others can get to know you better!
profile.noSummaryOther: This user has no summary yet.

contacts.title: Marketplace contacts
contacts.editHint: Opens the editor for this contact
contacts.infoOwn: Optional ways other traders can reach you outside the private chat. It adds to the chat, it doesn't replace it: deals are still completed there (PIN handover or tracked shipping) before reviews unlock. If you don't use the marketplace, you can ignore this.
contacts.infoOther: Other ways to reach this user outside the private chat. Deals must still be completed in the marketplace chat (PIN handover or tracked shipping) before either of you can leave a review.

overlay.draftNote: Changes are saved when you tap Save on the contacts card.
overlay.facebookUsernamePlaceholder: The username from your profile link
overlay.facebookHowTo: How to find your Facebook username

facebookSteps.step2: Tap Menu in the top corner.
facebookSteps.step3: Tap Settings and privacy, then Settings.
facebookSteps.step5: Choose a profile, then tap Username.
